# Placeholder register: every mockup control and the real action it becomes

Lane PLACEHOLDERS, design-system pass, 26 September 2026. Ticket "Register the placeholders and the real actions they become" (#314) on the map "Ops Astro design system" (#287). It answers to `DIRECTION.md`, point 6: the look is canonical; the behaviour shows what the software must really do; the build makes it real and tracked; bugs are never copied. Plan and document only.

The owner, 26 September 2026 (verbatim): *"the mock up is literally that a mock up it is to mock up what the software should be able to do in practice as opposed to in theory"*, and later: *"i need you to take initiative and be able to discern what the correct functionality is but if there is ambiguity or if there's maybe some conflicting information then i would like to be addressed with that other than that please address the roadmap and follow it directly for the functionality in use case of all of these modules in combination"*.

## How to read this register

- **One row per interactive control**: every inventory element with a click, keyboard, hover-reveal, drag, input or toggle behaviour, reached through `PAGE-MAP.md` to its catalogue id. Identical controls that repeat (every row tick on a board, every card's Dismiss) are one row with the ids or the id range.
- **Control**: element id(s), catalogue id and variant, label or icon, page and surface. **Look**: a link to the component's shots (the "Looks" list near the end links each state's shot) and the states this control has. **Mockup today**: what it does now, with the handler's `file:line` in `dashboard-mockups`; any bug is written "Bug (not copied)" with its defect id from the page inventory or `TICKET-PLAN.md` section 5. **Capability**: what Ops Astro must really do. **Tracked action**: the record or event it creates or changes, who may do it, and whether it is audited. **Source**: where that action is already defined.
- **Tracked action.** Command and table names are the roadmap's own where it has them (`task.create`, `task.comment`, `task.decide`, `gate_decisions`, `grants`, `audit_events`, and so on). "Audited" means appended to the business's audit chain (`audit_events`): every write to shared business data, decisions, grants, money and permissions. Per-person view preferences, pure navigation and reads are not audited (the roadmap keeps no view log: `docs/decisions/delivery-and-presence.md:25`).
- **Source.** `MP-x-y` is a ticket in `docs/mockup-inventory/TICKET-PLAN.md`; `R<n>` a ruling there (decided answers come from the closed grilling tickets #301 to #306, and the other 34 from the ticket-plan pass of 27 September, `evidence/BUILDREADY.md` "Pass 2"; each reads "answered" or "decided" with its outcome, and R1 and R68 were answered by the owner, `CAPABILITY-SLICES.md` "Owner answers"); `WIRING §n` is the owner's own law in the mockup's `WIRING.md`. **candidate** means nothing defines the action yet: the row proposes a ticket title for the build map, and "decided: intuitive" marks behaviour chosen here because the roadmap is silent. The roadmap is the authority for functionality. `AUTHORITY: <area>` names the roadmap area a row relies on (read from `docs/roadmap.md`, `docs/build-plan.md`, `docs/decisions.md`, `docs/planning-index.md` and the closed map #1 tickets). The citation beside it is the source. Citations give the repository path and line in full (the short keys an earlier version used were resolved on 27 September by lane RECONCILE-CAPABILITY; the key map is in `evidence/RECONCILE-CAPABILITY.md`). `WIRING §n (line x)` is `WIRING.md` in the mockup repository (`dashboard-mockups`), not this one. `research/task-demo-spec-2026-09-11/SPEC.md` is ratified (#12); the two September contracts under `research/` are drafts.
- **Fresh audit.** Each covered row ends with `fresh:` and the ids of the capability-first audit rows (`evidence/fresh-audit/`) that confirm it. Rows the fresh pass found missing carry a `FA-` id as their control and the look id RECONCILE-LOOK assigned (filled in at build-ready; where the control is not drawn, the look names the existing components it is built from). **Control-id prefixes:** the WORKBENCH rows use `WSH-` for the inventory's workbench `SH-` ids, and the task page's missing-task rows use `TKM-` for the inventory's TASKS `TM-` ids, so no id means two controls (map in `evidence/RECONCILE-CAPABILITY.md`).
- **Not in the register.** Display-only elements (tiles, meters, chips, static cards), tooltips on labels, and section wrappers. On the client workspace, 40 elements whose only "behaviour" is a typed placeholder figure are left out. Each must show real data or its empty state (R65): `BR-29`, `BR-32`, `BR-33`, `BR-34`, `BR-38`, `BR-40`, `BR-48`, `BR-49`, `BR-51`, `BR-53`, `BR-54`, `WK-07`, `WK-08`, `WK-10`, `WK-11`, `WK-12`, `WK-18`, `WK-19`, `WK-22`, `MO-07`, `MO-12`, `TR-03`, `TR-05`, `TR-06`, `TR-07`, `DSY-02`, `DSY-03`, `DSY-04`, `DSY-05`, `DSY-06`, `DSY-10`, `VO-01`, `VO-03`, `VO-04`, `VO-07`, `AC-01`, `AC-02`, `AC-06`, `AC-08`, `AC-13`.

| `DP-19` · DS-PRIM-5 · Client select · dock task panel field grid | [DS-PRIM-5](#look-ds-prim-5): default, hover, focus-visible, open | Sets `client` while the task is empty, in its canonical look; once the task has content it shows locked, in the same look, with the line "This task has content, so its client is locked. Bug (not copied): D-05. | Change the task's client while it is empty; duplicate it without contents once it is locked. A task's client can be changed only while the task is empty: its history holds nothing beyond its creation and earlier client changes, so no comment, file, doc, time entry, link, approval or other change. The change is one step, through `task.set_party`, on every path (the app, the API and the command line), by a person holding `task:share`; an agent is refused. Once the task has content its client is locked, with no move and no unlock on any path: `task.set_party` refuses with `CLIENT_LOCKED` (409) and writes nothing (`S0-5 client change refused once the task has content`, `MP-4-8 locked task refuses a client change`). To serve another client, "Duplicate without contents" (`task.duplicate`) makes a new task for the chosen client from the bare shell only (title, type, and the names of its checklist items and subtasks), which the person sees and can edit first; the old task is untouched, and the new task's business-internal history records "duplicated from" the old task's id (`MP-4-8 duplicate carries only the shell`, `MP-4-8 duplicate gives no way back to the old task`). This is the owner's design of 28 September 2026 (owner line 75), which replaced the closed-world move. | `task.client changed` · agency member with share authority; `task duplicated` · agency member with task write for the chosen client · audited | MP-4-8; AUTHORITY: party link only via `task.set_party`, and only while the task is empty (`research/fixed-slots-2026-09-10/CONTRACT.md:293`) · fresh: `FA-TASKS-54` |

## Candidate tickets for the build map

Deduplicated across pages. Each is a control whose real action no ticket, ruling or roadmap passage defines yet. The behaviour is decided (intuitive) in the row and is not a question for the owner. **Reconciled 27 September** against `evidence/SLICE-INVENTORY.md`: 13 of C1 to C22 are already planned and now point to their ticket (no doubling up); 9 stay new; C23 to C36 were added from the fresh audit, so 23 were new candidates in all. **On 27 September the owner put C27, C29 and C30 out of scope**, so 20 stood (lane LIVE-SYNC; C4 rewritten to live sync). **On the owner's review of the list** (lane LIST-EDITS), C13 was deferred and C37 to C43 were added from lane NEW-CAPS (`evidence/NEW-CAPABILITIES.md`), so 26 stood. Lane AUDIT-RECONCILE added C44 to C62 (45 stood), and the owner's answers of 27 September added C63 to C65 (lane ANSWERS24, `evidence/OWNER-ANSWERS.md`), so **48 stand**. Lane RESEARCH-FOLD added C66 to C68, and lane GRILL-FOLD added C69 and C70 on the owner's live grilling of map #396 (`evidence/GRILL-FOLD.md`). `CAPABILITY-SLICES.md` places each in its slice.

| # | Proposed ticket title | Controls | Capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | Estate search with ⌘K | SHELL `SH-14` | Keyword and structured search over what the person may see, opened by click or ⌘K / Ctrl K; disabled with a tooltip until built (R29), hidden on the portal. **Reconciled:** stays a new candidate (slice and phase in `CAPABILITY-SLICES.md`). |

## Behaviour decided

These rulings ask how a control behaves, not how it looks, so they were moved off the design-system map into this register (the triage that moved them was a working file outside git; each ruling's text and status are in `docs/mockup-inventory/TICKET-PLAN.md` and the closed grilling tickets #301 to #306). Each is decided here; none is a question for the owner. "Decided" answers come from the closed grilling tickets (#301 to #306); R77 is decided by this register on the owner's sidebar law, and the owner decided on 27 September that the timer is built in the Tasks phase, outside the first-slice (T1) demo.

| Ruling | Decision | Capability the mockup demonstrates | Tracked action |
|---|---|---|---|
| **R77** Running timer when the task panel closes or another task opens (#306) | Closing the panel, or opening another task in it, stops the timer and logs the elapsed time as a time entry; it is never discarded. The mockup's discard is the bug. The owner's law: the close "must REACH THE TENANT (... stop the timer ...)" (`dashboard-mockups/WIRING.md:2208-2210`). | A person times work on a task and the time is always kept. | `time entry created` (a `time_entries` row: task, person, start, end, duration, ad hoc flag) on stop or close · the timing agency member · audited (the roadmap has no time-entry shape yet: `docs/roadmap.md:120`, `docs/platform-construction.md:94`) |
| R16 Settings: theme and General (#301) | `/settings/` General holds You (Appearance Light / Dark / System, default System; Guided tips) and This business (four-eyes threshold, client sign-off, conversation window, retention window). | Each person picks their theme and tips; the business sets its thresholds once. | `preference saved: appearance`, `preference saved: guided tips` · that person · not audited; `business_settings` changed · agency owner/admin · audited |
| R17 Agency / Client face switch (#301) | Shows only inside `/clients/:client/*` and `/portal/:client/*`; pressing the face already on does nothing. | Flip between the agency's and the client's view of one client. | `none: navigation` · agency member · not audited |

### Decided by this register

Questions the page passes met that the roadmap leaves open but that have one obvious reading. Each is decided here and written into its rows.

| Where | Decision | Tracked action |
|---|---|---|
| Timer (TASKS, DOCK, SHELL) | The timer really tracks time. Start opens a running time entry; Stop, closing the task panel, or opening another task in it logs the elapsed time with the task's Ad hoc default. One running timer per person; the app-strip Start timer (C3) is the same timer. R29's "disabled until built" governs only the phase before the timer is built. | `time entry created` · the timing person · audited |
| Pin (TASKS `DP-10`) | Pin is personal ("your list" in the mockup), so it is stored per person, not in the shared `favourite` field (`research/fixed-slots-2026-09-10/CONTRACT.md:311`). | `preference saved: pinned task` · that person · not audited |
| Workbench Share (`WSH-04`) | v1 copies an internal link; sharing a tab with the client comes with the per-tab client exposure toggle (C18). | none (clipboard) |
| Promote to recommendation (WORKBENCH) | Promote creates a task carrying the proposal (`task.create`, then `task.propose`), so "the approval queue" is the list of open gates; no second approval record type (`docs/decisions/execution.md:49`, `research/task-demo-spec-2026-09-11/SPEC.md:541`). | `task.create`, `task.propose` · agency member · audited |
| Enquiry outcome (CLIENT `WK-20`) | The client marks the outcome on the report; the agency records outcomes it hears first from the lead's CRM record. Both carry the actor. | `enquiry.outcome` recorded · client person with a grant, or agency member · audited |
| Agency Review twin (BOARDS `R-07`, `R-08`) | The agency's Approve and Request changes record the agency's own internal review round, labelled as the agency's; the client's decision stays on the client face (R18). | `task.decide` (agency round) · agency member with gate authority · audited |
| Connector table paging (AGENCY, MP-14-7) | Fold at 8 rows, per decided R49; MP-14-7's "pages of 10" is amended to match. | none |
| CRM Remove (DOCK) | Remove ends the person's link to the client; the person is never deleted (`docs/decisions/records-and-authority.md:33`). | record link removed · agency member · audited |

## Owner answers

Moved on 27 September to the one deduplicated list at the end of [`CAPABILITY-SLICES.md`](CAPABILITY-SLICES.md#owner-answers), which the owner answered in full the same day. Of the five that stood here, items 1, 2, 3 and 5 were settled from the roadmap and decided rulings; item 4 (a client taking back an approval, PH-4) was answered there as item 3.
